data.name: Charlie
data.description:
Charlie was one of the Velociraptors that are being trained by Owen Grady that appears in Jurassic World.  She was the youngest of the four trained raptors.

Physical Appearance

In Jurassic World and its official site, Charlie is forest green with dark green vertical stripes running down her back. Her skin pattern is the result of using Green Iguana DNA in her genetic coding.  She has a Cloaca that is roughly 3-3.5 inches deep, making her deeper than her sisters.  She is approximately 3.3 meters long and 1.3 meters tall, making her slightly smaller than Blue and Delta, though she is a little larger than Echo.

Personality

The youngest Velociraptor in Jurassic World, Charlie was known for being a bit of a suck-up to Blue, often passing up meals to appease her, while clumsily smacking Delta and Echo in the face with her tail. Blue appeared to be distressed upon thinking she lost Charlie and attacked the people who tried to blow her up. Charlie is also the gentlest Velociraptor. Even if the I. rex ordered her to do it, she refused to hurt humans. This might be due to the fact the DNA of the herbivorous green iguana was inserted into her. This had given her green scales with black stripes.  Like Delta, Charlie has a little PTSD from her near death, although she is much much hornier than her sisters as a coping mechanism, though she has never had sexual interactions before due to a lack of male dinosaurs on the island.  She is also submissive compared to her sisters 

History

Creation

Charlie was created by InGen as an attraction for the IBRIS Project.  She is the youngest of the park's Velociraptor pack consisting of Blue, Delta, and Echo.  Her skin pattern is the result of using the DNA of the green iguana (Iguana iguana) in her genetic coding.  In her birth, she imprinted on Owen Grady, who trained her along with her sisters.

Jurassic World Containment Breach

Just before the incident occurred, Charlie and the rest of her pack attempted to strike Leon, a newly hired Jurassic World employee who had fallen into her pack's paddock, while trying to capture a pig that had escaped its holding pen. However, they were thwarted by their trainer in time to save Leon's life. Later that night, Charlie and her pack were outfitted with infrared cameras strapped to their heads and were used to stop the rampage of the genetic hybrid Indominus rex. When they found the hybrid, the I. rex began to communicate to them, becoming the leader of their pack, giving them the command to kill the humans that were following them. They followed this order and proceeded to attack the humans that were trying to stop the Indominus. Charlie pounced on an InGen Security Division trooper and dragged him away before killing him. While devouring the aforementioned trooper, she saw her trainer Owen Grady, who refused to shoot her. Charlie also hesitated to attack Owen due to their bond, staring at him in a curious matter rather than an aggressive manner. Seconds later, one of the InGen troopers fired a missile launcher at Charlie, although it would end up striking a tree and the minor shockwave from the blast would only knock her out, the troop who fired would assume she was dead and thus she would be left there, only waking up after the Indominus was killed and no known human survivors were on the island.

Like Blue, Charlie learned an important lesson on trusting creatures that can speak the Velociraptor language due to the fact it nearly got her killed.  

Five years later, when Isla Nublar was in danger of being destroyed by Mount Sibo, Charlie and her sisters would meet an individual they had not seen in a long time, a feral white lion named Greenstar, who had helped train them after birth, and had been the one to have Owen chosen as the trainer.
Charlie and her sisters would be rescued by Greenstar in a race against time and against InGen due to Mount Sibo’s impending eruption despite Greenstar being banned from returning to the island due to controversy surrounding his assistance in funding the Raptors and park Monorail. Charlie and her sisters would be relocated much to their anger until they would learn that Greenstar did it to save them from an InGen trap. InGen is still currently after Charlie and her sisters at the time of the roleplay.
In the post relocation, Charlie and her sisters seem interested in gaining a new island home to live on. Currently her and her pack are hiding on Board the RMS Queen Elizabeth II, a former Cunard OceanLiner now owned by Klaus, who is Greenstar’s adopted Father. She and her sisters were relocated due to the volcano threatening to explode, and barely got rescued before it did, destroying their original home.
Like her sisters, Blue, Echo, and Delta, Charlie was created by InGen who had received funding help from General Greenstar, for the IBRIS Project sometime before 2015 as the Fourth raptor of the project.
